why: A SEPARATE BRANCH, not a stage onto bloodline: bloodline is PROPOSED as v1.0.1 and staging would make that proposal stale and un-freeze a decision already accepted. Aimed at the one measured cost bloodline pays -- stall 5 games in 100 to 8 -- WITHOUT touching the gains it bought. The diagnosis says this is a curve problem and not a mana problem: supply is identical to v1.0.0 (mana at turn five 4.944 against 4.936, missed land drops 0.404 both), and mana_short rose 40% purely because bloodline swapped two- and three-drops for six-drops. So attack it from both ends. CURVE DOWN seven mana: Vish Kal at seven is the card the field ranks #15903 and that two earlier revisions both cut; Bloodtracker pays life for counters a sac deck gets free; Unbounded Potential is a pump spell. ACCELERATION IN: Culling the Weak sacrifices a token for BBBB, so it is ramp that eats fuel the deck already makes and turns turn three into a six-drop turn -- the pilot's stated T4/T5 pump. THE COUNTER ENGINE: The Ozolith banks counters off every creature that LEAVES the battlefield, which in a deck built on sacrifice means every eaten body reloads onto the next giant, for one mana. Aetherborn Marauder is the body that collects them, with flying and lifelink. Vault of the Archangel gives the whole team deathtouch and lifelink from a LAND slot rather than a spell slot, and it costs only a white source in a deck already at its white target while black and red are the short colours. NO COUNTER DOUBLER EXISTS IN THIS IDENTITY -- Ozolith, the Shattered Spire is green -- so that lever is unavailable and is not being chased.
